# DSL Specification Proposal

Thank you for proposing an improvement to DSL.

Please complete all relevant sections before submitting the proposal.

A proposal is not part of the official DSL specification merely because an Issue has been opened.

The proposal must follow the review and governance process defined in `GOVERNANCE.md`.

## Proposal ID

DSP-XXXX

## Status

DRAFT

## Problem

What problem does this proposal solve?

Describe the problem clearly and explain why it matters to DSL users or the wider digital communication environment.

## Proposed Change

What exactly should be added, changed, or removed?

Describe the proposed change in precise terms.

## Meaning

If the proposal introduces a new signal, hashtag, syntax, or rule, define its exact meaning.

## Examples

Provide practical examples of how the proposed change would be used.

Example:

`#DSL #EXAMPLE`

## Compatibility

Explain whether the proposal:

- changes existing DSL behavior;
- introduces a new signal;
- changes syntax;
- affects existing implementations;
- creates any backward-compatibility concerns.

## Safety and Abuse Considerations

Identify possible misuse, ambiguity, manipulation, harassment, impersonation, spam, or other unintended consequences.

Explain how these risks could be reduced.

## Alternatives

Describe other approaches that were considered and explain why this proposal is preferred.

## Final Notes

This proposal is subject to public review.

Opening an Issue does not automatically change the DSL specification.

Only a proposal that successfully completes the defined review and decision process may become part of a future DSL specification.
